Package index

Try it out

The fastest way to see what EpiSODIC does, with no data or configuration of your own required.

episodic_demo()
Try EpiSODIC with synthetic outbreak data

Run EpiSODIC

The two calls that run a real instance: detect on a schedule, and open the dashboard for your board to review the results.

episodic_run_cron()
Run one surveillance detection cycle
episodic_run_app()
Open the EpiSODIC dashboard
episodic_resolve_data()
Resolve a data source argument to a data frame

Connect your own data

How to plug in your laboratory results and, optionally, testing volume and hospital activity data - and how to check your extract against the contract before you run anything.

episodic_case_columns episodic_care_lines episodic_institution_types episodic_sex_codes
Connect your own laboratory data
episodic_check_cases()
Check your case data before you hand it to EpiSODIC
episodic_check_denominators()
Check your positivity data before you hand it to EpiSODIC
episodic_check_institution_activity()
Check your hospital activity data before you hand it to EpiSODIC
episodic_validate_cases()
Check that your case data has the right shape, or stop
episodic_synthetic_cases()
Generate synthetic outbreak data
episodic_synthetic_cases_calibration()
Generate synthetic data at tunable cluster volume
episodic_synthetic_denominators()
Add a testing-volume (positivity) feed
episodic_synthetic_institution_activity()
Add a hospital activity feed (patient-days)

Set up a database

Create and connect to the database EpiSODIC stores its data in.

episodic_db_create()
Set up a new EpiSODIC database
episodic_db_connect()
Connect to an existing EpiSODIC database
episodic_db_open()
Connect using the EPISODIC_DB environment variable
episodic_db_truncate()
Empty every EpiSODIC table, keeping the schema itself
episodic_db_dsn_mariadb() episodic_db_dsn_mysql()
Connect EpiSODIC to a MariaDB or MySQL server

Notifications

Send alerts to your team when new clusters are detected or a detection run fails. Supports ntfy, SMTP, sendmail, Microsoft 365, Teams, and Slack.

episodic_notifications
How notifications work
episodic_notify_test()
Send a test notification through all configured channels
episodic_setup_microsoft365()
Set up Microsoft 365 authentication for notifications
